subs.note: Chansons, madrigals and other songs, in all their voices.

items.title: Entre vous filles (Clemens)
items.desc: Jacobus Clemens non Papa, Entre vous filles, before 1550. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
